画面中，一只穿着蓝白波点睡衣的橙色小熊抱着一个大南瓜，站在木栅栏旁，背景是树屋和南瓜堆，一只小鸟停在栅栏上。

page_text_ocr_zh:
熊王国九月初的一天，秋高气爽，阳光灿烂。熊妈妈收获了本季最后一茬南瓜，正在把它们高高地码到独轮手推车上。这时，远处传来熊爸爸嘹亮的喊声：“顺——山——倒！”熊妈妈知道，他又伐倒了一棵树。
她自言自语地说：“但愿熊爸爸和孩子们小心点儿。”
page_text_en:
One day in early September in Bear Country, the weather was crisp and sunny. Mama Bear had harvested the last batch of pumpkins of the season and was stacking them high on her wheelbarrow. At that moment, from afar came Papa Bear's loud shout: "Down the mountain—go!" Mama Bear knew he had felled another tree.
She murmured to herself, "I hope Papa Bear and the children are careful."
summary_zh: 本页描绘了熊王国九月初秋高气爽的一天，熊妈妈正在收获南瓜，而熊爸爸在远处伐树，熊妈妈担心他们的安全。

page_text_ocr_zh: “轰隆！”随着一声巨响，树倒在了地上。熊爸爸干活一贯小心谨慎，他用大锯子熟练地锯断了这棵树，和孩子们往后退了几步，看着树倒在小熊哥哥和小熊妹妹用树枝、树叶铺好的一片空地上。
page_text_en: "Boom!" With a loud crash, the tree fell to the ground. Bear Dad, always careful and cautious while working, skillfully sawed through the tree with his big saw. He and the children stepped back a few paces, watching the tree fall onto the clear space that Brother Bear and Sister Bear had prepared with branches and leaves.
summary_zh: 熊爸爸用大锯子锯倒了一棵树，孩子们在一旁后退观看，树倒在了小熊哥哥和小熊妹妹用树枝树叶铺好的空地上。

page_text_ocr_zh:
树叶落下，灰尘散尽了。小熊妹妹说：“瞧！这上面有圆圈！”
小熊哥哥说：“真的哩！有点儿像把石头扔到池塘里荡起的波纹！”
熊爸爸解释说：“这叫年轮，它能告诉我们树有多大了。”
page_text_en:
The leaves fell, and the dust settled. Little Bear Sister said, "Look! There are circles on it!"
Little Bear Brother said, "Really! It's kind of like the ripples when you throw a stone into a pond!"
Bear Dad explained, "These are called tree rings. They can tell us how old the tree is."
summary_zh: 树被砍倒后，小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥发现树桩上有圆圈，熊爸爸向他们解释这是年轮，可以用来判断树的年龄。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊妹妹开始数这些圈圈，但数到十就数不下去了。小熊哥哥接着数：“……二十五，二十六，二十七！哇！这棵树二十七岁了！”
小熊妹妹说：“比我大多了！”
小熊哥哥笑着说：“那当然了！你才五岁。”
小熊妹妹不服气地说：“快六岁了！”小熊哥哥已经八岁了，这使小熊妹妹感到很懊恼。不管她怎么长，都永远赶不上哥哥，这似乎很不公平。
page_text_en:
Little Bear Sister started counting these rings, but she couldn't go past ten. Little Bear Brother continued counting: "...twenty-five, twenty-six, twenty-seven! Wow! This tree is twenty-seven years old!"
Little Bear Sister said: "That's much older than me!"
Little Bear Brother smiled and said: "Of course! You're only five years old."
Little Bear Sister protested: "Almost six!" Little Bear Brother was already eight years old, which made Little Bear Sister feel very annoyed. No matter how much she grew, she could never catch up to her brother. It seemed very unfair.
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥在树桩上数年轮，哥哥数到二十七岁，妹妹因自己只有五岁（快六岁）而感到懊恼，觉得永远赶不上哥哥，产生不公平感。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊妹妹问：“爸爸，我们也有年轮吗？”
熊爸爸把她抱在腿上，说：“没有。但我们有有更好的记法——生日！还有生日聚会！噢，想起来了，你的生日快到了！”
page_text_en:
Little Bear Sister asked, "Daddy, do we have growth rings too?"
Bear Daddy held her on his lap and said, "No. But we have a better way to remember—birthdays! And birthday parties! Oh, I remember now, your birthday is coming up!"
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹询问自己是否有年轮，熊爸爸解释人类用生日来记录年龄，并提醒她的生日快到了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“会给我办一个生日聚会吗？”小熊妹妹边喊边兴奋地蹦着。小熊哥哥也激动起来：“咱们办一个非常漂亮的生日聚会好吗？”
熊爸爸说：“当然了，六岁生日可重要了！”
page_text_en:
"Will you throw me a birthday party?" Little Bear Sister shouted excitedly as she jumped up and down. Little Bear Brother got excited too: "Shall we throw a very beautiful birthday party?"
Bear Dad said: "Of course! A sixth birthday is very important!"
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹和小熊哥哥兴奋地向熊爸爸请求举办生日聚会，熊爸爸答应了，并强调六岁生日很重要。

page_text_ocr_zh:
孩子们太兴奋了，他们不停地喊：
“有蛋糕和冰淇淋吗？”
“有装饰物吗？”
“有礼物吗？”
“有游戏吗？”

他们回到家。熊妈妈说：“嗯，
生日聚会？对，六岁生日是需要庆祝一下，咱们可以办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会。”
page_text_en:
The children were so excited, they kept shouting:
"Is there cake and ice cream?"
"Are there decorations?"
"Are there gifts?"
"Are there games?"

They returned home. Bear Mom said: "Well,
birthday party? Yes, a sixth birthday deserves a celebration. We can have a cheerful, quiet little gathering."
summary_zh: 孩子们兴奋地询问生日聚会的细节，熊妈妈回应说可以举办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会来庆祝六岁生日。

page_text_ocr_zh:
但是，小熊妹妹、小熊哥哥和熊爸爸可不想办一个愉快、安静的小型聚会。他们满脑子想的都是办一个热闹、刺激的大型聚会——

邀请许许多多的客人，

有好多好吃的东西，

游戏，游戏，玩不完的游戏，
page_text_en:
But, Little Bear Sister, Little Bear Brother, and Bear Dad didn't want to have a cheerful, quiet small party. They were all thinking about having a lively, exciting big party—

Inviting many, many guests,

With lots of delicious food,

Games, games, endless games,
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹、小熊哥哥和熊爸爸希望举办一个热闹刺激的大型生日聚会，而不是熊妈妈提议的安静小型聚会，他们想象着邀请许多客人、吃美食和玩各种游戏。

page_text_ocr_zh:
墙上到处挂满装饰物，
收到成堆奇妙的礼物，
还有一个精美诱人的生日蛋糕！
熊妈妈说：“可别兴奋得昏了头。你们难道没有听说过‘忙碌过度的生日’吗？”
熊爸爸和孩子们满不在乎地说：“忙碌过度的生日？怎么会有那样的生日呢？”
page_text_en:
The walls are covered with decorations,
Receiving piles of wonderful gifts,
And there's a delicious birthday cake!
Bear Mom says: "Don't get too excited. Haven't you heard of a 'busy birthday'?"
Bear Dad and the children say carelessly: "A busy birthday? How could there be such a birthday?"
summary_zh: 熊妈妈提醒孩子们不要过于兴奋，提到‘忙碌过度的生日’，而熊爸爸和孩子们则不以为然，认为不可能有这样的生日。

page_text_ocr_zh:
熊妈妈叹了一口气，她希望

但是没多久，她也把忧虑忘

生日蛋糕越做越大，

page_text_en:
Bear Mom sighed. She hoped
she could control the situation.

But soon enough, she also forgot her worries
and began to immerse herself in excitement and busyness……

The guest list grew longer and longer.

The birthday cake got bigger and bigger,
and also more and more elaborate.
summary_zh: 熊妈妈起初担忧生日聚会的规模，但很快被兴奋和忙碌所取代，开始列长长的客人名单，并制作越来越大的生日蛋糕。

page_text_ocr_zh:
生日用品和食品越堆越高。

熊爸爸和孩子们忙着装饰树屋的里里外外。
page_text_en:
Birthday supplies and food are piled higher and higher.

Daddy Bear and the children are busy decorating the inside and outside of the treehouse.
summary_zh: 熊爸爸和孩子们正在为小熊妹妹的生日聚会忙碌地准备，生日用品和食品越堆越高，他们一起装饰树屋的内外。

page_text_ocr_zh:
盼望已久的日子终于到了。熊妈妈早早就把生日礼物——一件漂亮的褶边衬衫送给了小熊妹妹。这样，她就可以穿着新衣服参加生日聚会了。
熊爸爸说：“哦，太好了！小马和旋转木马到了。”
熊妈妈有点儿不相信自己的耳朵：“什么东西到了？”
熊爸爸说：“哦，我没告诉过你吗？我租了小马和旋转木马！”
page_text_en:
The long-awaited day had finally arrived. Bear Mom had already given the birthday gift—a beautiful ruffled blouse—to little Bear Sister. This way, she could wear her new clothes to the birthday party.
Bear Dad said, “Oh, great! The little horse and the carousel have arrived.”
Bear Mom couldn’t believe her ears: “What arrived?”
Bear Dad said, “Oh, didn’t I tell you? I rented the little horse and the carousel!”
summary_zh: 生日当天，熊妈妈送给小熊妹妹一件新衬衫，熊爸爸兴奋地宣布租来了小马和旋转木马，熊妈妈对此感到惊讶。

page_text_ocr_zh: 孩子们太激动了——特别是小熊妹妹！这将是一个多么盛大的聚会呀！
page_text_en: The children are so excited—especially little bear sister! This will be such a grand party!
summary_zh: 孩子们为小熊妹妹的生日聚会感到非常兴奋，画面中展示了装饰华丽的旋转木马和小马，预示着一场盛大的庆祝活动即将开始。

三点整，客人们

物堆成了小山。然
后，大家一起做起了

第一个游戏叫“去耶路撒冷”。
游戏规则是：大家围成圈，一圈一

page_text_en:
At three o'clock, the guests began to arrive one by one. They wished Little Bear Sister a happy birthday, and the gifts they brought piled up into a small mountain. Then, everyone started playing games.

The first game was called 'Go to Jerusalem'. The rules were: everyone formed a circle, spinning around and around. When the music stopped, the person standing on the small rug was eliminated. The game was so much fun — unfortunately, Little Bear Sister was the first one eliminated.
summary_zh: 生日聚会正式开始，客人们陆续到来并送上礼物，随后大家玩起了名为“去耶路撒冷”的游戏，小熊妹妹不幸成为第一个被淘汰出局的人。

page_text_ocr_zh: 接着，他们玩“转瓶子”游戏，这也很有意思——可是小熊妹妹太害羞了，她只敢亲小熊哥哥一个人，引得所有的孩子都哈哈大笑，开她的玩笑。
page_text_en: Next, they played the 'spin the bottle' game, which was also fun — but little bear sister was too shy. She only dared to kiss little bear brother, which made all the children laugh and tease her.
summary_zh: 生日聚会上，孩子们玩起了“转瓶子”游戏，小熊妹妹因害羞只亲了哥哥，引得大家哄堂大笑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
玩“钉驴尾巴”游戏时，
情况可就不同了，小熊妹妹
一下就钉对了地方。

但她却不能得奖——这
是她的生日聚会，拿奖品是

page_text_en:
Playing the 'Pin the Tail on the Donkey' game, 
the situation was different—Little Bear sister 
managed to pin it in the right spot.

But she couldn't win the prize—this 
was her birthday party, and it would be 
impolite for the birthday girl to win.
summary_zh: 在生日聚会上，小熊妹妹玩“钉驴尾巴”游戏时准确地钉对了位置，但因为是她的生日，大家认为她不能获奖，以免失礼。

page_text_ocr_zh: 然后，他们分发小礼物。小熊妹妹得到了一个可伸缩吹管，她吹到了弗雷德的鼻子上，弄得他鼻子直发痒。弗雷德得到的是一个魔法塑料花，他把小熊妹妹的生日衬衣喷得湿淋淋的。
page_text_en: Then, they distributed small gifts. Little Bear Sister got a collapsible blow tube; she blew it onto Fred's nose, making his nose itch. Fred got a magic plastic flower; he sprayed Little Bear Sister's birthday shirt until it was soaking wet.

小马和旋转木马是最受孩子们欢迎的。但小熊妹妹吃得太饱了，她骑在上面，上上下下地颠着，一圈一圈地转着，觉得有点儿恶心。

最后，生日蛋糕上来了，该吹灭六根蜡烛了。小熊妹妹深深地吸了一口气，用尽全身力气吹了出去……
结果，一根也没吹灭。

The little horse and the carousel are the most popular with the children. But Little Bear Sister had eaten too much. She was riding on it, bouncing up and down, spinning round and round, and felt a bit sick.

Finally, the birthday cake arrived. It was time to blow out six candles. Little Bear Sister took a deep breath and blew with all her might……
But in the end, not a single candle was blown out.
summary_zh: 生日派对上，小熊妹妹因吃得太饱，在骑小马和旋转木马时感到恶心；随后她尝试吹灭生日蛋糕上的六根蜡烛，但未能成功。

page_text_ocr_zh: “你吹几下，长大就会有几个孩子！”朋友们喊着，用古老的迷信跟她开玩笑。她吹了好几下，才终于吹灭了所有蜡烛。大家欢呼起来，齐声唱起了“生日快乐”歌。
page_text_en: "Blow a few times, and you'll have that many children when you grow up!" the friends shouted, teasing her with an old superstition. She blew several times before finally extinguishing all the candles. Everyone cheered and sang "Happy Birthday" together.
summary_zh: 小熊妹妹在朋友们的玩笑和鼓励下，吹灭了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛，大家随即齐声唱起生日歌庆祝。

熊妈妈问：“宝贝！怎么了？”
小熊妹妹抽抽搭搭地说：“太不公平了！

Bear Mom asked, "Sweetie! What's wrong?"
Little Bear Sister sniffled, "It's so unfair!
Playing 'Go to Jerusalem', I was the first one out! I don't like the kissing game! I didn't get the prize for 'Pin the Tail on the Donkey'! Fred got my new shirt wet! And besides, I don't want six kids—I only want three!" Then she started crying again.

"I do hope Papa and the cubs are being careful," she said.

she never caught up with him. It didn't seem quite fair.

party with all the trimmings?" Brother was excited too.
"I don't see why not," said Papa. "Six is a pretty important birthday."

"Didn't I mention it?" said Mama. "I rented ponies and a merry-go-round for the party!"
The cubs were very excited—especially Sister! What a party this was going to be!
8. At three o'clock sharp the guests began to arrive. They greeted Sister, piled up their presents, and joined the fun.
The first game was Going to Jerusalem. You play it by going around and around, and the one that's caught on the rug when the music stops is out. It was lots of fun—except that Sister was the first one out.
